title_en: ★(Subject to Change) Schedule of Public Presentations for Master's and Doctoral Thesis Examinations, 2nd Semester of the 2026 Academic Year
summary: The department announces that the public presentation schedules for master's thesis examinations and doctoral preliminary examinations for the 2nd semester of the 2026 academic year are provided in two attached files. The schedules may change at any time, so attendees must check the attached files again on the day of the examination.
applies_to: Attendees of the public presentations, such as students taking the Master's/Doctoral Seminar [석박사세미나].
steps: Download and check the attached schedule file for master's examinations [2026-2학기 석사 심사 일정.pdf] or doctoral preliminary examinations [2026-2학기 박사 초심 일정.pdf] on the notice board post.
On the day of the examination, check the attached file again, as the time, venue and other details may have changed.
Direct any questions to the department office (Building 301, Room 319); contact details are in the original notice.
translation:
★(Subject to Change) Schedule of Public Presentations for Master's and Doctoral Thesis Examinations, 2nd Semester of the 2026 Academic Year

Posted: 2026-11-02

We announce the schedule of public presentations for master's and doctoral thesis examinations for the 2nd semester of the 2026 academic year.

1. Master's public presentation schedule
- Please refer to the attached file. (The content may change at any time.)

2. Doctoral public presentation (preliminary examination [초심]) schedule
- Please refer to the attached file. (The content may change at any time.)

3. Notes
- The public presentation schedule (attached files) is updated from time to time. As the time, venue and other details may change, attendees, including students taking the Master's/Doctoral Seminar [석박사세미나], must check the attached files again on the day of the examination.

4. Inquiries
- Department office [학부행정실] (Building 301, Room 319). The contact person, phone number and email address are given in the original notice.

Attachments (2):
- 2026-2학기 박사 초심 일정.pdf (Doctoral preliminary examination schedule, 2nd semester 2026; 153 KB)
- 2026-2학기 석사 심사 일정.pdf (Master's examination schedule, 2nd semester 2026; 143 KB)

Note from the translator: The attached files containing the actual schedules were not read; their contents are not included in this translation. Please consult the attachments on the original notice.
